name: yopedia
install: export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 && corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.9 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Next.js dev server (Turbopack) on http://localhost:3000. Reads are public; wiki content lives on the local filesystem under ./wiki and ./raw. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or another provider key) and Clerk keys in .env.local for ingest/generation and authenticated writes.
